reason: I buy fabric at my local shop where I can feel the drape before I cut into it. I'd only order online if the shop didn't have what I need, and a plain black viscose is something they always have.
objection: I can't touch it, so I don't know how heavy or drapey the viscose really is. And if I need it for a project this week, what if it's out of stock or stuck on pre-order?
would_change_my_mind: A cheap swatch or sample pack so I can feel the fabrics first, plus clear in-stock status with next-day InPost delivery.
